mapper.select: SELECT * FROM enterprise_verified_identity WHERE verified_identity_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enterprise_user_permission ( enterprise_id, user_id, permission, enabled, revision, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{enterpriseId}, #{userId}, #{permission}, #{enabled}, #{revision}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (enterprise_id, user_id, permission) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, revision = EXCLUDED.revision, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at WHERE EXCLUDED.revision > enterprise_user_permission.revision OR ( EXCLUDED.revision = enterprise_user_permission.revision AND EXCLUDED.enabled = enterprise_user_permission.enabled AND EXCLUDED.updated_at = enterprise_user_permission.updated_at )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM enterprise_user_permission WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND enabled = TRUE ORDER BY permission FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enterprise_device ( device_id, enterprise_id, device_key_id, public_key_format, public_key_encoded, public_key_digest, algorithm, trust_source, managed_status, compliance_status, revision, registered_at, revoked_at, disabled_at ) VALUES ( #{deviceId}, #{enterpriseId}, #{deviceKeyId}, #{publicKeyFormat}, #{publicKeyEncoded}, #{publicKeyDigest}, #{algorithm}, #{trustSource}, #{managedStatus}, #{complianceStatus}, #{revision}, #{registeredAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{disabledAt} ) ON CONFLICT (device_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM enterprise_device WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM device_enrollment_grant WHERE code_digest = #{codeDigest} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_challenge ( challenge_id, purpose, verified_identity_id, client_instance_id, expected_device_key_id, expected_public_key_digest, nonce, audience, allowed_algorithms, challenge_digest, issued_at, expires_at, consumed_at, consumed_by, consumed_request_digest ) VALUES ( #{challengeId}, #{purpose}, #{verifiedIdentityId}, #{clientInstanceId}, #{expectedDeviceKeyId}, #{expectedPublicKeyDigest}, #{nonce}, #{audience}, #{allowedAlgorithms,jdbcType=ARRAY,typeHandler=com.robothree.central.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.PostgresTextArrayTypeHandler}, #{challengeDigest}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{consumedAt}, #{consumedBy}, #{consumedRequestDigest} ) ON CONFLICT (challenge_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM device_challenge WHERE challenge_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO access_token_issuance ( token_id, token_digest, enterprise_id, user_id, device_id, client_instance_id, permissions, identity_digest, device_revision, permission_revision, issued_at, expires_at, challenge_id ) VALUES ( #{tokenId}, #{tokenDigest}, #{enterpriseId}, #{userId}, #{deviceId}, #{clientInstanceId}, #{permissions,jdbcType=ARRAY,typeHandler=com.robothree.central.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.PostgresTextArrayTypeHandler}, #{identityDigest}, #{deviceRevision}, #{permissionRevision}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{challengeId} ) ON CONFLICT (token_id) DO NOTHING
